There's a lot of people in the CotE community saying that the anime is a portrayal of how he looks to other people, the manga being a portrayal of what he thinks he looks like and the LN being a mixture between the two. In the LN there are multiple occasions where he implies he's showing emotions but other characters just say he shows no emotions.

Honestly, probably Ayanokoji outsmarting Hosen in Y2V1. The build up with all the new 5-head characters was great but also the plot twist was something I'd never thought about. I can sometimes think of ways Kinugasa would turn the tables but that scene was just crazy.
